_about: Swordsman base body from the user's sprite (look_ref.png): concept in the A-pose with his scimitar, views, TRELLIS.
concept_prompt: A lean desert swordsman warrior: a brown hooded robe and cloak, a cloth mask over his face below the eyes, layered brown and tan wrappings, a sash at the waist, wrapped forearms, simple boots. A curved scimitar held in his right hand, pointing down. Hand-painted fantasy game art style, the same colours and look as Image 2.
